items.text: Advanced Excel skills for jobs mean cleaning messy data, using lookups and conditional logic, summarising with pivot tables, building simple dashboards and automating repeated steps, and you can prove them with a few workbooks that solve realistic office problems.
Practise on realistic messy data, build three workbooks that each solve a business question and explain your method in plain language.
Check which functions they name and avoid paying for certificates that promise jobs.
